messages:
Ana G: Heads-up — Helios-mini-ptq (INT8, PTQ) is in the staging canary. Latency/throughput look fine but structured toolcall parse rate spiked. staging-bot posted run: https://ci.internal/redwood/canary/helios-mini

Poornima: Numbers? Is this similar to earlier PTQ runs or a new pattern? :eyes:

Lee (Eval): Canary summary: samples=1024, toolcall_parse_fail=3.95% vs fp16 baseline 0.09%. Failure taxonomy I'm seeing: (1) trailing-suffix free text after JSON, (2) truncated array ends, (3) unexpected escape chars breaking parser. Top templates: multi-step checklists and code-snippet followups.

Ben: Example from artifacts (redacted):
```
{"op":"fetch","args":{"path":"/deploy.md","lines":20}}
Also confirm the prod env has the flag.
```
Model emits correct object then continues with a sentence. Downstream linter treats as hard-fail.

Ana G: I reproduced locally with streaming + kv-cache enabled, batch=9. If I flip kv-cache off or increase streaming_chunk to 48 tokens failure drops ~80%. Hypothesis: PTQ token rounding + streaming chunk boundary leads to punctuation token differences and continuation.

Poornima: Short-term mitigation options: A) opt-in non-blocking repair/rescue in the serving adapter that finds the last balanced brace and trims trailing tokens before parsing; B) introduce a tolerant post-lint that accepts re-ordered keys and additional benign fields for canary only. Thoughts?

Lee (Eval): Prefer A for short-term so we don't mask regressions. We'll add a "rescued=true" tag to telemetry when repair succeeds and retain original_fail counts. I'll export the top-250 failing prompts to eval harness (erun-58666H) for a matrix run.

staging-bot: Canary report: model=Helios-mini-ptq(int8), samples=1024, parse_fail=3.95%, mean_rt=136ms, link=https://ci.internal/redwood/canary/helios-mini/results

Ben: Also noticed a subset where the JSON is valid but contains backslash-escaped newlines ("\n") inserted inside strings, likely from tokenization shifts. The parser treats them differently. We should include an escape-normalization step in rescue heuristics.

Ana G: Agreed. Proposed short-term plan: implement non-blocking json_rescue that: 1) finds last balanced brace, 2) strips trailing free text, 3) normalizes escape sequences and trailing commas, 4) attempts json.loads. If rescue passes, mark telemetry as rescued and attach both payloads. If not, surface as fail.

Poornima: Long-term: run quant-bisect (per-channel vs per-tensor, symmetric/asymmetric calibration) + tokenizer drift check. I'll run the bisect and replicate eval matrix with kv-cache toggled.

Lee (Eval): Action items: @Lee -> run eval matrix across fp16, int8(per-tensor), int8(per-channel), and int8 with kv-cache disabled (erun-58666H) by EOD. @Poornima -> start quant-bisect jobs and share config diffs. @Ben -> prototype json_rescue filter (opt-in per-canary) and ensure telemetry tagging. We'll hold wider rollout until either parse_fail < 0.5% on the matrix or rescue+telemetry accepted by SRE.

Ana G: Thanks team. Let's sync tomorrow AM with the evaluation matrix and rescue PR. :thumbsup:
